title: Approve CSR & Grant Namespaced Access
prompt:
A pending Kubernetes `CertificateSigningRequest` named `dev-cka-csr` has been submitted for user `jane-cka` to authenticate via `kubernetes.io/kube-apiserver-client`.

Perform the following tasks:
1. Approve CertificateSigningRequest `dev-cka-csr`.
2. In namespace `cka-csr`, create Role `dev-pod-ops` permitting `get`, `list`, and `create` on `pods`.
3. In namespace `cka-csr`, create RoleBinding `jane-pod-ops` binding Role `dev-pod-ops` to User `jane-cka`.

docs_links.label: Manage TLS Certificates in a Cluster

hints: Inspect CSR status with `k get csr` and approve it using `k certificate approve dev-cka-csr`.
Remember to bind a User subject (`--user=jane-cka`) rather than a ServiceAccount.

manifests:
apiVersion: certificates.k8s.io/v1
kind: CertificateSigningRequest
metadata:
  name: dev-cka-csr
spec:
  request: 
  signerName: kubernetes.io/kube-apiserver-client
  expirationSeconds: 86400
  usages:
  - client auth

apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: dev-pod-ops
  namespace: cka-csr
rules:
- apiGroups: [""]
  resources: ["pods"]
  verbs: ["get", "list", "create"]

reference_solution: Approve `dev-cka-csr`, create Role `dev-pod-ops`, and bind it to User `jane-cka`.
